recipe.visualDefinition: A layered collage composition featuring a sepia-toned photograph of two men in suits and sunglasses, overlaid on a piece of torn, handwritten parchment paper, all set against a clean white background with a prominent 3D beveled logo.
coreVisualRelationships: Torn paper edges contrasting with the sharp rectangular photo frame
Sepia and cream tones unified against a stark white void
Heavy 3D typography overlapping both the photo and the parchment
Cursive background text acting as a texture rather than readable content
coreInvariants: Rough, deckled edges on the parchment layer
Soft drop shadows under all layered elements to create depth
Metallic or beveled finish on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is positioned slightly left of center, occupying about 40% of the canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, beveled logo in the lower right quadrant serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast photo on the left, move right across the parchment texture, and settle on the heavy 3D lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central collage, focusing all attention on the layered elements.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; value contrast is high within the photo but low between the parchment and white background.

letterConstructionRules: Interlocking characters where the tail of one letter flows into the next
Heavy 3D beveling with a top-down light source
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'K' features an elongated, sharp horizontal bar
Lowercase 'j' characters have circular, orb-like dots
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display lettering paired with delicate, handwritten cursive for a 'personal note' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, aggressive but elegant look of the main logo.
Matches the background and subtitle handwritten aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage on a white background. On the left, a vertical rectangular sepia photo of two men in 90s suits and sunglasses. Behind it and to the right, a piece of cream-colored parchment paper with torn, deckled edges featuring faint, illegible cursive handwriting. Apply soft drop shadows to both layers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, custom-lettered logo in the lower right, overlapping both the photo and the paper. The lettering should have a heavy 3D bevel effect in olive-gold tones. Below it, add a small subtitle in elegant, dark-brown cursive script.

verificationChecks: Ensure the paper edges look physically torn, not digitally cut.
Check that the 3D bevel on the text has a consistent light source.
Verify the photo is strictly sepia/monochrome.
Confirm the background cursive is light enough to be a texture.

adjustableVariables: Tear intensity of the paper edges
Depth of the 3D bevel on the logo
postGenerationChecks: Does the collage feel like physical objects on a white surface?
Is the 3D text legible despite the heavy beveling?
Is the sepia tone consistent across the photo and the parchment shadows?
Are the torn edges realistic and varied?
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered [Subject Photo] + [Torn Parchment with Script] + [3D Beveled Display Type] + [White Negative Space Surround]
